review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse access control and parent-resource fallback enforcement
review.reason: Adds warehouse tables to RESOURCE_FALLBACK_MAP and implements helper functions to resolve parent resource IDs, establishing a fallback access-control chain from warehouse tables to their external data sources. observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No score is assigned; tier assignment requires a score and an explanation, not just observations.

observations.behavior: Adds a new access-control rule: warehouse tables now also check the parent external data source, not just warehouse-level rules.
observations.posthog_connection: This establishes a fallback parent relationship between warehouse tables and their external data sources, allowing access checks to propagate from warehouse tables up to their parent source. This could prevent unauthorized access to warehouse tables when the parent source is denied, while still allowing warehouse-specific rules to override source-level denials.

observations.behavior: Adds warehouse_table to RESOURCE_FALLBACK_MAP, establishing warehouse tables as children of external data sources.
observations.posthog_connection: This explicitly registers warehouse tables as dependent on their parent external data source, enabling the fallback parent access check. This could help enforce source-level access controls on warehouse tables, potentially preventing unauthorized access to warehouse tables when the parent source is denied.
